title: Threat Intelligence IOC v1
description: Schema for a single Indicator of Compromise (IOC) record in the threat intelligence pipeline. All inserts are idempotent by ioc_id. Expiration and active flags control lookup eligibility.

ioc_id.description: Globally unique IOC identifier. Primary idempotency key — inserting the same ioc_id twice is a no-op.

ioc_type.description: Indicator type. Determines how value is matched against telemetry fields.

value.description: The indicator value. For ip: IPv4/IPv6 address. For domain: FQDN (lowercased). For url: full URL. For file_hash: SHA-256 hex (lowercased).

severity.description: Threat severity assigned by the source. Used in shadow alert severity field.

source.description: Feed or analyst source that provided this IOC.

first_seen.description: Earliest known observation of this indicator.

last_seen.description: Most recent observation of this indicator.

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp after which this IOC is no longer active. Null = no expiration.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-to-live in seconds from created_at. Used to compute expires_at if not explicitly set.

active.description: Whether this IOC is currently active. Inactive IOCs are excluded from lookups.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this IOC was first loaded into the store.

normalization_version.description: IOC normalization version. Always 'ioc-v1' for this schema.
